subject: Discovery: NovaCare — data logging, retention & PII constraints
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lopez <jamie.lopez@novacare.io>, Michael Chen <m.chen@novacare.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (data logging / retention)

Jamie / Michael — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the conversation captured and a clean handoff internally.

What we heard (pain points)
- Logging and PII: you need strict controls around PHI/PII in inference logs (no raw user content persisted beyond a short retention window unless redacted).
- Retention policy: primary ask is configurable retention between 30–90 days with admin-driven purging, plus audit proof for deletions.
- Auditability: requests must have an immutable audit trail (who, when, model version, route), and easy export for audits.
- Private networking: traffic must originate/terminate inside your VPC for the pilot; data-in-transit and at-rest encryption required.
- Redaction: ability to apply token-level redaction (or automatic redaction rules) before any long-term logging.

Your current stack / constraints
- AWS (us-west-2) + internal ETL layer that prefixes and normalizes user messages.
- HIPAA-bound workflows — you mentioned you are a covered entity and require a BAA and SOC2 evidence.
- Peak inference profile: ~15k short prompts/day today, spiking in testing; success criteria will be stable latency and demonstrable logging controls.

Success criteria (as discussed)
- Ability to enforce a 30–90 day configurable retention window with admin-triggered purges.
- No unredacted PHI in long-term logs; token redaction or on-the-fly redaction applied in pipeline.
- Access to exportable audit logs for 12 months (or a signed agreement on snapshot export for audits).
- Pilot must run inside a VPC/private deployment (we agreed to test Dedicated/Private options).
- Baseline latency: P95 for short prompts under 700ms with predictable throughput under a 50k tokens/day pilot.

Attachments (attached)
- NovaCare_Security_Questionnaire_20261003.pdf (your security questionnaire you mentioned)
- NovaCare_Logging_Requirements.xlsx (your logging/retention spreadsheet)

Proposed next steps
1) I will share answers to the questionnaire and a short tech note on our redaction options (attached).
2) Schedule a technical follow-up with one of our infra engineers to align on VPC setup and log export formats — please share 1–2 windows next week.
3) We will prepare a scoped pilot proposal (Dedicated capacity + Private control plane) and include an initial estimate for token pricing and expected cost delta for redaction/logging.
4) Karthik will follow up on contracting/BAA questions.

Can you confirm the following by reply: (a) retention target you want to start with (30 / 60 / 90 days), (b) whether auto-redaction must run inside your network, and (c) best availability for a 60-minute technical call next week?

Thanks — I’ll get the questionnaire answers back to you by EOD tomorrow.

— Ben

Ben — really helpful write-up, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: we spoke quickly on the call but want the specifics captured.

Clarifications / constraints
- Retention: we want to pilot at 30 days retention for all inference request bodies; metadata (timestamps, route, model version) can be retained for 12 months for audit purposes.
- Redaction: auto-redaction should operate before any write to long-term storage. For the pilot we're OK with redaction rules run in your service if the data never leaves our VPC unredacted (would prefer it to run in our VPC or a customer-dedicated subnet).
- Audit logs: exportable CSV/JSON with request id, timestamp, model version, route, user id (hashed) — must be available on-demand.
- Contracting: we require a signed BAA before any production pilot.

Availability: Next week Mon 10/05 10–11am PT or Tue 10/06 2–4pm PT work for the technical deep-dive.

I attached the questionnaire (filled) and an XLS with our logging column expectations. Also copied our infra lead Michael — he will join the technical call.

Thanks — Jamie

- Retention: start pilot at 30 days for request content, 12 months for metadata exports.

Suggested internal next steps:
1) Monica: can you pull the SOC2 Type II PDF and the BAA template so we can send to NovaCare? (I’ve attached Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf).

3) I will book the technical deep-dive for Mon 10/05 10:00am PT per Jamie's availability.

We should also include a simple pilot scope: dedicated pool for 8 weeks, expected 50k tokens/day (bursty), dedicated VPC peering, admin console with retention controls.

Jamie — great, appreciate the quick confirmation and the filled questionnaire. Confirming next steps from my side: 
- We will send a BAA and SOC2 materials by EOD today (Monica is looping and will upload the docs).
- Karthik will run the technical deep-dive Mon 10/05 at 10:00am PT (calendar invite incoming).
- I’ll attach a 1-page tech note on redaction options (inlined below) and a pilot cost estimate before the call.

Quick tech note (summary)
- Options: a) In-VPC redaction: Redwood runs redaction logic in a customer-dedicated subnet (best for compliance, modest latency increase). b) Pre-send redaction: customer-side redaction using our SDK (lowest runtime cost, most control).
- Logging model: metadata-only export available by default; full request logs only stored when redaction rules mark content as non-sensitive.
- Admin controls: console toggle to set retention (30/60/90), manual purge, and export snapshot for audits.
- Performance: expected +5–15% token processing overhead for token-level redaction depending on rules; we’ll quantify in the pilot estimate.

Meeting link (technical deep-dive) — calendar invite to follow. Please flag if you want security/legal on the call.

Looking forward — Ben
